bio: Prepare for a sensory overload the moment you set foot into Lakruwana—the Sri Lankan hot spot is covered from floor-to-ceiling in murals, sculptures, flags, and more. The kaleidoscope of textures and colors is a welcome sight, as is the energetic owner who drifts from table to table.Street food takes center stage here, where you a variety of traditional dishes hit the mark. Don't miss the kottu roti, a stir-fried dish with godamba roti, chicken, vegetables and chicken curry or the traditional hoppers, with its bowl-shaped crepe served with a yellow fish curry. The oversized platter is ideal for sharing....
